entities.summary: Laura Michele Fortino is a Canadian and Italian ice hockey defenceman and coach. She has played in the Italian Hockey League Women (IHLW) with Real Torino HC Femminile since 2025. A former member of the Canadian national team, she won two Olympic medals and six World Championship medals during 2011 to 2019.
